name: Food and water bowl
reason: A bowl is one object for dogs and cats (harvested bowls are sold 'dog and cat'); applies_to tag dogs; rule 3.1.

name: Dog muzzle
definition: a basket, cage or strap fitted over a dog's muzzle to stop it biting or scavenging.
reason: Generic type sold under its own name; restrains the dog, so steering and restraint; HS 4201 also names muzzles.

name: Pet carrier
reason: Carriers are sold for dogs, cats and small mammals alike; one kind in Several animals (rule 3.1).

name: Pet pen
reason: A pen sold only for pets is B10.11.3 (K-103).

name: Pet gate
reason: A gate sold only for pets is B10.11.3 (K-103); child-and-pet gates are B8.

name: Flea, tick and worm treatment
reason: Existing kind covers all three parasites for dogs and cats.

name: Dog waste bag
definition: a bag made for picking up and disposing of a dog's droppings.
reason: Product for the animal's own toilet is B10 (B-33, as cat litter); new Dogs leaf Care and hygiene, next free leaf number.

name: Pet door or cat flap
definition: a flap or small door fitted in a door, wall or window that lets a cat or small dog pass in and out.
reason: Cat flaps and pet doors are one design sold for cats and small dogs: Several animals (C14c). Report gave no URL: attest at fetch.

name: Cat scratcher
definition: a post, pad or board of sisal, cardboard or carpet made for a cat to scratch.
reason: Sold under its own name apart from the cat tree; scratching post is B10 furniture (memo §9). Report gave no URL: attest at fetch.

name: Girth
reason: Girth is already a saddle part (CV-17).

name: Stirrup
definition: a foot rest hung from a saddle for the rider, with or without its leather.
reason: Part made for one B10 object (saddle); parts follow the whole, as the girth (C5(d), S3).

name: Martingale
definition: a strap or straps from the girth to the reins or noseband that limit how high a horse carries its head.
reason: Generic tack type sold under its own name (SmartPak tack list); controls the head, so steering and restraint.

name: Cooler rug
definition: a wicking rug worn by a horse to dry and cool off after work or washing.
reason: Memo §4b: horse rugs are kinds by use (turnout, stable, cooler, fly).

name: Fly rug
definition: a light mesh rug (fly sheet) worn by a horse against flies.
reason: Rug by use (memo §4b); distinct from the fly mask, which covers only the face.

name: Overreach boot
definition: a bell-shaped boot (bell boot) worn round a horse's pastern to protect heel and coronet.
reason: Horse boots are kinds by boot type (memo §4b); covers a different part of the leg than the tendon boot.

name: Curry comb
definition: a rubber, plastic or metal comb with rows of teeth used to loosen dirt and hair from a horse's coat.
reason: Not a brush; sold as its own grooming tool, so not a named form of horse grooming brush.

name: Lunge line
definition: a long line fixed to a horse's headgear by which it is worked in a circle round the handler.
reason: 'Lunging gear' is a shop group; its generic core is the lunge line. Lunge cavesson and roller are harvest follow-ups.

name: McClellan saddle
reason: A single iconic US cavalry design on a Spanish-derived tree; nearest tradition kind Western saddle; tradition tag US cavalry. Provisional reading.

name: Australian stock saddle
definition: a saddle of the Australian stock-riding tradition, with knee pads (poleys) and a deep seat.
reason: Memo §4b: saddles are kinds by riding tradition and lists Australian stock; neither English nor Western covers it (C2(c), C11).

name: Pack saddle
definition: a frame saddle that carries a load, not a rider, on a pack animal.
reason: Carries a load, not a rider; memo §4b lists pack among saddle kinds; leaf is carrying a rider or load.

name: Aquarium air pump
definition: a pump that blows air into an aquarium through a line and air stone.
reason: Aeration is a separate equipment type (Maxi Zoo, Pet Circle pumps); habitat life-support like filters and heaters.

name: Aquarium water treatment
definition: a liquid or additive that conditions aquarium water (dechlorinator, bacterial starter, clarifier, algae control).
reason: Maxi Zoo Entretien lists water treatment beside tests; for the habitat, not B6 cleaning; care and hygiene leaf.

name: Bird cage
definition: a wire cage in which a pet bird is kept.
reason: B10.7 has no kinds by design; the cage is its housing kind. New leaf, next free number.

name: Bird perch
definition: a rod, branch or platform fitted in a cage for a bird to stand on.
reason: Sold under its own name among cage accessories; furnishes the cage. New leaf, next free number.

name: Bird swing
reason: A design of bird toy (as dog-toy play forms); not a separate kind.

name: Bird toy
definition: an object made for a cage bird to chew, forage, climb or play with.
reason: Cage-bird toys are bird-specific and sold as their own group, like dog toy. New leaf, next free number.

name: Cage-bird feeder or drinker
definition: a cup, dish, hopper or drinker fitted to a bird cage.
reason: Fixed to cage bars, so not the generic food bowl; one kind as poultry feeder or waterer. New leaf.

name: Cage-bird nest box
definition: a nest box or nest pan fitted to a cage or aviary for breeding birds.
reason: B10.8.3.01 is made for wild birds; animal group first (K-102) gives cage birds their own kind.

name: Flea, tick and worm treatment
reason: Parasite treatment kind covers single-species products (as cat-only NexGard there); applies_to adds cage birds.

name: Bird feeding station
reason: A pole carrying feeders is the feeding station (RSPB feeding-stations page).

name: Feeder hook or bracket
definition: a hook, bracket or hanger made to hang one bird feeder.
reason: Accessory made for one B10 object (bird feeder); parts follow the whole (C5(d)). New parts leaf, next free number.

name: Hummingbird feeder
definition: a feeder with ports that gives nectar or sugar water to hummingbirds.
reason: Feeder design by food (memo §4b); nectar feeding differs from seed, suet and nyjer designs.

name: Hopper feeder (camera attribute)
reason: Rule T (C10): a camera is connectivity on a feeder design; no fetched comparison ranks camera feeders apart yet.

name: Queen excluder
definition: a grid laid between hive boxes that keeps the queen out of the honey supers.
reason: Part made for one hive; parts follow the whole (B10.12.1); fits the hive-system platform.

name: Comb foundation
definition: a wax or plastic sheet embossed with cell bases, fitted in a hive frame.
reason: Sold apart from the frame (Thorne 'Frames and Foundation'); part made for one hive.
K-105: bee suits are A1 personal protective equipment (A1 3.2).
K-105: bee veils are A1 personal protective equipment (A1 sub-family 6).

name: Varroa treatment
definition: a medicine, strip or vapour that controls varroa mites in a honey bee colony.
reason: Veterinary goods are B10; made for bees only, so Bees, new leaf health and veterinary (next free number).

name: Brooder heating plate
definition: a heated plate on legs under which chicks keep warm.
reason: Small brooder gear is B10, herd gear C7 (K-101); habitat life-support beside the small incubator.

name: Pet water fountain
definition: a powered bowl that circulates and filters drinking water for pets.
reason: Rule T(b): the pump and reservoir change form from a bowl; sold for cats and dogs, so Several animals.

name: Automatic pet feeder
definition: a timed or app-controlled dispenser that releases portions of dry food for pets.
reason: Different form from a bowl (hopper and dispenser); sold for cats and dogs, so Several animals.
